MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

2. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

3. Solve for x: x + 7 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 12

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

5. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

6. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 19
   C. 7
   D. 23

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

9. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 77
   B. 36
   C. 22
   D. 18

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 30
   D. 105

14. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

15. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

16. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

17. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 48
   D. 49

18. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 81

19. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 36
   C. 13
   D. 5

20. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

21. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 1

   D. 20

22. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37

   D. 31.7

23. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11

   C. 24

24. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14

25. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)

26. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)

27. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)

30. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
